input.subject: Sync fails with timeout — full diagnostics attached
input.body: Our nightly sync job has failed three nights in a row with a timeout after 30 seconds. Here is everything I have gathered so far. Client log line 1: connecting to sync endpoint ok. Client log line 2: handshake completed in 210ms. Client log line 3: uploading batch 1 of 14 ok. Client log line 4: uploading batch 2 of 14 ok. Client log line 5: uploading batch 3 of 14 stalled at 30s then aborted with ETIMEDOUT. I retried with batch 3 alone and it succeeded in 4s, so the data itself is not corrupt. I then ran the full job again and it failed on batch 5 instead, again at exactly 30s. Our network team confirms no packet loss to your edge. The sync worked fine every night until Tuesday. Nothing changed on our side that day as far as we can tell. I also tested from a second office on a different ISP and saw the same 30 second stall. Account ID is 8f31c. Happy to share full packet captures privately if that helps. Reproducing the failure takes about 90 seconds end to end, so it should be easy to observe on your side if you tail the sync service logs for our account around 03:00 UTC.
